name: Razorpay
lede: Razorpay is preparing for its IPO while launching agentic banking and new global payment rails. Airtable keeps product, compliance and go-to-market teams working from one source of truth.
why_h2: IPO readiness alongside a fast launch cadence
why_p: Three moves since April 2026 that each span several teams and need auditable coordination.

signals.title: Draft prospectus pre-filed
signals.body: Razorpay pre-filed its draft prospectus on 12 June 2026 for an IPO expected to raise about US$600 million.
signals.angle: Listing readiness means auditable, cross-functional programmes. Airtable keeps owners, status and evidence in one place.

signals.title: RazorpayX agentic connected banking
signals.body: RazorpayX launched what it calls India's first agentic connected banking experience, letting businesses initiate payouts through conversational AI.
signals.angle: Fast-moving product teams need a shared source of truth for roadmap, launch and GTM work.

signals.title: Google Pay cards and UPI in OpenAI Codex
signals.body: Razorpay became the first Indian payment aggregator to enable card payments through Google Pay for businesses worldwide and launched UPI inside OpenAI's Codex.
signals.angle: Partner launches span product, compliance and marketing. Airtable bridges them without re-keying.
